summary.text: David Weatherspoon is an ordained Baptist minister and the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee State Senate, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He also sought the Democratic nomination for the seat in 2018.

paragraphs.text: David Weatherspoon earned a bachelor's degree from Belmont University in 1998 and an M.Div. from Mercer University in 2003.

He has worked as a chaplain and minister for Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare, Franklin College, Grady Hospital, Peachtree Baptist Church and Emory University, and was a chaplain participant in White House discussions in 2010 and 2012.
Weatherspoon ran in the August 2, 2018 Democratic primary for Tennessee State Senate District 31, finishing second with 42.7% of the vote behind Gabby Salinas, who received 48.0%.
